correctness.rationale: The exact co-rotating Hopf flow F_t(z)=e^t z/sqrt(1+(e^{2t}-1)|z|²) is a finite-time radial diffeomorphism with Jacobian e^{2t}(1+s|z|²)^-2. Divergence theorem on D_{a,R} produces the stated explicit area formula. If a≠R, uniform radial projection on the initial boundary gives boundary C1 limits and limits of 2π or twice the arc angle; if a=R, radial segments show the image sets converge to a filled right half-disk, while two narrow monotone radial endpoint layers add 2 to the semicircle perimeter π. Scaling θ=π+ue^-t gives the limiting diameter profile -iau/sqrt(1+a²u²). Taylor expansion of the area formula gives e^-t tangency correction versus e^-2t off tangency. Independent numerical boundary-flux quadrature matched exact area to <7e-16 for (a,R,t)=(0,.8,2),(.6,.6,3),(1.4,.8,2). Independent perimeter values at t=6: 6.283174 (disk), 5.099552 (half disk; limit π+2≈5.141593), and 2.432981 (arc; limit 4 asin(.8/1.4)≈2.433). Finite numerics corroborate, not prove the limits.
